reference_policy.checked: One independent cross-engine/stability-checked reference replaces its known-bad raw value; original and replacement are recorded in uniform_reference_audit.
reference_policy.missing: Absent/nonpositive/nonfinite LD reference; report separately, never as a pass.
reference_policy.saved: Existing saved independent reference, with no new convergence certification.
reference_policy.unresolved: 114 uniform discrepancies fail the existing strict cross-engine/stability criterion; report separately, never as passes.

replay.excluded_comparisons: trace_values.csv LD labels use uniform reference columns, so LD-vs-uniform comparisons are excluded.
replay.method: Saved candidate_error > 0.001 and baseline_error <= 0.001; no numerical solver executed.

selection.holdout: 32 configurations reserved before survey selection; 16 hash-selected positions each; no configuration overlaps with difficult or survey.
selection.neighbors: Two nearest saved x/y positions within the same configuration per hard row; distance ties use dense_row.
selection.scope: Frozen coverage samples of the existing caustic-centered grid; not a population error estimate or a new physical domain.
selection.survey: 384 rows from distinct other configurations; covers every available exact q/s/rho level and 5x5x5-by-route strata, filled by stable hash ranking.

source_hash_scope: Historical validated baseline, not the current checkout; removed modules may appear as provenance only.
